desc: Introducing the Rebel .22 - .22 LR just got better, and more fun! Get ready for the most fun you've had with a .22LR. Brand new for 2020, POF brings you the Rebel .22. To say that POF is extra excited about this one would be an understatement. They have yet to have someone shoot the Rebel and not walk away with a big smile. POF's love of shooting, training, and prepping future shooters were the driving factors of development. They had to bring a quality to this platform which hasn't been seen before. Aside from its light weight, the Rebel is equipped with a Quick Detach End Plate and 1/2-28 threaded barrel with Enhanced Pressure Device. The receiver accepts AR-15 pattern stock and brace options, and the trigger and selector are also compatible with AR-15 options. It also features a monolithic upper receiver and injection molded lower receiver. To top it off, it accepts the widely available 10/22 magazine. NOTE: The included Enhanced Pressure Device is NOT a silencer
